text.p: Textile machinery and engineering group Saurer AG said it expects 1996 net profit to be higher than a May forecast of 10 million Swiss francs.
Sauer said in an interim report to shareholders that major restructuring was progressing faster than expected, boosting profits despite a weak world market.

"Despite difficult market conditions and a clear drop in sales in the area of spinning machinery, the reserves built into the Saurer annual budget for unforeseen risks will not be needed," the group said.
"We therefore expected a result for the financial year 1996 that is above the amount forecast in the spring," its said.
In May, Saurer said it expected 1996 net profit of about 10 million Swiss francs and an operating result of about 40 million.
In 1995, Saurer posted a net loss of 75.2 million francs.
